scope: ATS dining-room roller shutters and Vita tuck-shop scale/frontage. Read-only research; no project or UE edits.

direct_user_confirmation.tuck_shop: Vita tuck shop should be larger and face the current user view.

direct_user_confirmation.weight: Direct user observations; do not override them with an ambiguous photograph.

new_useful_asset.source_credit: The report credits the school for the flood/cleanup photographs.
new_useful_asset.relationship_to_existing: Same event/angle as the small 2023 school-news dining image, but this is a higher-resolution source image, not an AI enlargement or an independent second angle.
visually_verified: White ceiling beams and columns; pale patterned mosaic on lower walls and columns, black narrow top border and dark skirting.
Tall multi-pane windows, long suspended fluorescent fittings, ceiling fans and blue wall fans.
White long tables with blue/aqua plastic chairs, stacked and moved during flood cleanup; arrangement is not normal seating evidence.
Grey closed surface left of the first main column, with a central vertical joint and long housing above. Horizontal shutter slats cannot be resolved convincingly.
Large grey reflective rectangular wall panels on the right; these should not automatically be interpreted as rolling shutters.
cannot_establish: Metric size or total width of the entire room.
Which of the user's three drawn door positions is visible.
Exact shutter profile, colour, dimensions, guide-rail design or motor housing.

other_reviewed_assets.observation: Open double doorway towards a covered walkway and railings. The location is not labelled as the dining entrance, and it should not be copied to the dining plan.
School-hosted dining photograph: white long tables, blue chairs and people eating; no entrance or shop frontage is visible.

other_reviewed_assets.source_page: https://www.goodschool.hk/news/學業品德相得益彰　多元舞台盡展鋒芒
other_reviewed_assets.observation: Students reading at round white tables with cream chairs, piano and balloon decorations. The article does not identify this as the dining room. Do not replace the established white-long-table/blue-chair references with this different room.
Only a small brown latched door portion is visible behind eating students. Its purpose and connection are unknown; it does not establish that all dining entrances are hinged wooden doors.

supplier_only_not_ATS.observation: Official supplier page describes school-specific frontage designs and shows a branded counter, but does not identify the school in that image. It cannot establish ATS frontage, shutter type or shop size.

search_outcome: No publicly verifiable ATS Vita tuck-shop frontage or close-up of the dining roller shutters was found in this bounded search. No photo-derived numerical shutter/shop dimensions are proposed.
implementation_guidance: Use the user's direct confirmation for upward-rolling restaurant entrances; do not retain the previous wooden swing-door interpretation.
Use the current UE camera to face the shop towards the user; web photos cannot resolve that orientation.
Fit the user-confirmed whole-G-floor room to the existing building envelope. Clearly retain model-derived dimensions as estimates.
Do not copy another school's counter proportions or stock/displays as if they were ATS evidence.
